source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES queries a literal six-slot range, proving no individual record, fitted population, FRU/feed mapping, model-specific raw status semantics, latch/freshness or UI fidelity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires six separate model-aware raw reads without fault injection. V3.1 additionally keys all outcomes to immutable serial/feed/role identities, handles mixed/unfitted slots and preserves the distinct STATUS_CRPS1~2 architecture.

old_problem: Six slots may be mixed-model, intentionally unfitted or hot-spare, and their standard/OEM PMBus bits can differ by firmware. A range, count, generic OK icon or single decoder could hide missing channels, simultaneous faults, sticky history, wrong slot/page mapping or a valid state that differs from active supplies.
disposition_reason: Disposition all six physical slots and bind every fitted status record to FRU serial/model/firmware, bay, feed, redundancy role and the correct PMBus standard/OEM sources and decoder. Preserve raw concurrent conditions and verify both UI summaries under unchanged load/redundancy without clearing or injecting faults. Inventory and decoder inputs are runtime readiness, not a remaining engineering decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 906, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest, preceding CRPS status/power cases, separate physical-service case and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed.
A six-row population matrix is required even when not all bays are fitted; absent/N/A is acceptable only under the approved chassis and per-model rules.
Each installed PSU needs its own decoder revision because standard and OEM bitfields, polarity and composite-state precedence can vary by model/firmware.
ED-03 forbids guessed OEM bits, ED-13 governs unfitted/standby states, ED-15 requires approved model decoders, ED-17 preserves fault history and ED-20 keeps every PSU slot separate from CRPS status.

test_case.test_name: Verify STATUS_PSU1 through STATUS_PSU6 as a complete serial-bound raw status matrix
test_case.purpose: Verify all six defined PSU slots have an approved fitted/unfitted status outcome and every fitted module's complete standard/OEM raw conditions map to the correct FRU, bay, feed and role and are decoded and displayed consistently in Dashboard and Server Health for the current power/redundancy configuration.
required_package: Chassis/power-backplane/BMC identity and approved six STATUS_PSU versus two STATUS_CRPS architecture
Slots 1-6 fitted state, FRU PN/serial/model/firmware/rating, AC feed and active/standby/hot-spare/redundancy role
Per-model PMBus bus/address/page and STATUS_WORD/STATUS_BYTE/substatus/OEM register definitions, polarity and decoder revision
Raw-bit mapping for present, power-good, input/output, fan, temperature, communication, standby, degraded and fault conditions including concurrent states
Stable SDR/API/UI identity, event masks, composite-state precedence, latch/sticky/clear ownership, BMC polling and UI propagation/freshness rules
Validated protected read-only BMC/browser client and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL, PMBus fault history, BMC or PSU logs and do not remove/reseat modules, switch feeds, change load/redundancy/hot-spare, reset or clear a PSU/BMC, inject faults, write registers or flash firmware. Build the six-row population/FRU/feed/role/decoder matrix. Enumerate complete inventory and read STATUS_PSU1 through STATUS_PSU6 separately; never send the tilde range, assume slot/page order or substitute STATUS_CRPS1~2. Review the Script before use. For each row capture defined absence or full raw standard/OEM words, concurrent decoded conditions, event masks, latch/freshness and timestamps plus matching Dashboard and Server Health evidence. Apply the correct model/role rule and stop without retry on missing, swapped, stale or divergent data.
test_case.expected_result: All six slots have an approved explicit outcome. Each fitted raw status source and both UI views agree on bay, FRU serial/model/firmware, feed, role and applicable decoded composite health, with accepted latch/freshness behavior and no hidden unaccepted concurrent condition. Unfitted, standby and hot-spare states follow their documented rules; CRPS summaries and numeric power do not substitute.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires six slot outcomes, model-correct raw decoder provenance and complete independent raw/two-UI evidence with engineer acceptance under current role/freshness rules. A literal range, count, generic green icon, CRPS summary, numeric power value, one decoder for mixed models or fabricated numeric threshold cannot pass. Missing/swapped/stale identity, unjustified N/A, unknown/incorrectly decoded bit, unaccepted degraded/fault condition or raw/UI mismatch is FAIL. Missing population/model status references/role rules is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS. Removal, AC loss, failover and fault clear/recovery are separate coverage.
safety_gate: Preserve SEL, PMBus fault history, BMC and PSU logs; do not clear intermittent/sticky evidence.
Explicitly disposition all six bays and bind fitted records to serial/model/feed/role and correct decoder; do not substitute CRPS status.
Do not apply one OEM decoder to another model/revision or flatten simultaneous bits into a top-level OK state.
Do not remove/reseat PSUs, switch feeds, change load/redundancy/hot-spare, reset/clear devices, inject faults, write registers or update firmware.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials, assume a cipher or execute an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/power-backplane/BMC identity and approved six-slot fitted/mixed-model population plus STATUS_PSU-to-CRPS relationship
Per-slot FRU PN/serial/model/firmware/rating/feed/role and PMBus bus/address/page/register plus stable SDR/API/UI identity
Complete raw standard/OEM fields, simultaneous decoded conditions, event masks, latch/history/freshness and synchronized timestamps with UI rows
Missing/swapped/unknown-bit/divergent disposition and pinned Script/client/decoder audit
Preserved fault history, no-service/no-reset-or-fault-injection/no-retry proof, final PSU/BMC health and six-slot engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is authorized. On population/decoder ambiguity, stale/lost data or unexpected PSU/BMC health, stop and preserve raw words, UI, logs and current feed/redundancy state. Obtain the correct per-model firmware reference and Project mapping and continue only read-only; do not reset or clear a supply to normalize status. Any later service/fault test requires separate authorization and recovery.

source_conflict.reason: This passive row consistently targets six per-slot status displays. The physical-service/temperature conflict exists only in another source case; population and decoder gaps are readiness inputs.

blocked.reason: The six-slot passive status objective and population-aware method are complete. FRU inventory and model-specific PMBus references can supply exact semantics without a fault.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Six-slot fitted/FRU/model/firmware/feed/role map, STATUS_PSU-to-CRPS architecture, per-model standard/OEM decoders, stable IDs, composite/latch/poll/freshness rules, role-specific acceptance and protected reviewed method.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ ONLY; NO PSU, FEED, LOAD, REDUNDANCY, RESET, FAULT-CLEAR/INJECTION, REGISTER OR FIRMWARE CHANGE; SCRIPT NOT APPROVED

external_authorities.title: Master-referenced internal sensor Script
external_authorities.application: Pin and review before use; it cannot define slot population, FRU/feed mapping, per-model OEM bits or role acceptance.

project_authority: Project slot/feed/redundancy map, PSU FRU inventory, each vendor PMBus firmware specification, BMC SDR/event mapping and WebUI schema define six outcomes.
